controls.requirement: A future acquisition may use only one approved official URL pinned to one revision.
Download into an empty quarantine directory that is not the Git work tree.
Do not import a model loader or execute repository files during download.
Record expected and observed file names, sizes, and SHA-256 digests in separate fields.
Accept only named safetensors weights plus the named tokenizer and configuration files.
Reject unexpected files, symlinks, executable bits, pickle headers, and torch.load checkpoints.
Do not enable trust_remote_code or any other remote modeling code.
A later load test uses local paths only and disables network fallback and telemetry.
Do not commit weights to Git and do not upload weights as CI artifacts.
Do not redistribute weights. This template does not grant redistribution.
